seo.title: Our Story | The Talisman, Karen, Nairobi since 2003
seo.description: How The Talisman began: two traders, a talisman above a shop door and an iconic house on Ngong Road in Karen, Nairobi, open since 2003.

hero_image.alt: The stained-glass window above the café tables at Talisman

top.page_heading:
An iconic location,
*and a light-bulb moment.*
top.intro: Opened at the end of 2003 by two people who had never run a restaurant.

image.alt: A carved wooden door frame and lamp inside Talisman

how_it_began.heading:
A talisman, bought
*above a shop door.*
how_it_began.text: Sharly and Ian Cameron traded kilims and carved furniture. In a shop in Afghanistan, Sharly spotted a talisman above the door: to ward off evil and bring good luck.

how_it_grew.heading: How it grew
how_it_grew.intro: Five years, they promised. More than twenty years later, it is still here.

milestones.title: Traders, not restaurateurs
milestones.text: Carpets, kilims and carved pillars, and the talisman above a shop door.

milestones.title: The light-bulb moment
milestones.text: Driving home with an empty fridge, they found the old plot was free.

milestones.title: Talisman opens
milestones.text: The pillars came out of storage. Five years, they promised each other.

milestones.title: Number one in Nairobi
milestones.text: Ranked the city’s number one restaurant.

milestones.title: Passed into good hands
milestones.text: Two regulars, Satyan and Stue, bought it and run it still.

milestones.title: An iconic location
milestones.text: The original fireplace and painted wall remain, with many of the first staff.

quote.quote: “I still love going there, and many of the original staff are there today to welcome one and all.”

now.heading:
Where we
*are now.*
now.an_iconic_location_text: Still on Ngong Road, in the same house, with the fireplace and painted wall intact.
now.eclectic_cuisine_text: Food from our own farm and from kitchens around the world, with chef’s specials daily.
now.art_and_music_text: Local artists on the walls and live music by the fire, all through the year.
